# Naviamp 2.9.0: desktop Cast and expanded downloads

Naviamp 2.9.0 brings Google Cast to desktop and lets you keep albums and artists downloaded.
It also adds fullscreen, Linux media controls and easier account switching on Android TV.

## Highlights

- Cast online music from desktop and control playback from Naviamp.
- Keep albums and artists downloaded with storage previews and shared track retention.
- Use fullscreen, Linux media controls and a remote-friendly TV account chooser.

## Features

- Cast online music and artwork from desktop to a reachable Google Cast receiver, control
  playback and seeking, and return to local listening at the current position. Closing the
  Windows sender ends Cast playback. ([Issue #171](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/171), [PR #216](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/216); [verification #168](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/168), [PR #222](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/222))
- Keep albums and artists downloaded, preview storage needs, recover interrupted transfers,
  and reuse tracks retained by other collections. New artist subscriptions default to favorite
  albums, with an explicit all-albums choice. ([Issue #150](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/150), [PR #182](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/182))
- Use fullscreen on desktop and restore the prior window size when leaving fullscreen.
  Wide views show a fullscreen button; compact players keep it in the actions menu.
  ([Issue #141](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/141), [PR #189](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/189); [layout #230](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/230), [PR #233](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/233))
- Control Linux playback, seeking, volume, shuffle and repeat through desktop media controls
  and MPRIS-compatible tools. ([Issue #119](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/119), [PR #193](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/193))
- Switch saved Android TV accounts with large remote-friendly cards and reuse their stored
  connections. ([Issue #53](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/53), [PR #201](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/201))
- Choose track or album artwork for individual albums while keeping the global default for
  everything else. ([Issue #145](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/145), [PR #179](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/179))

## Improvements

- Browse multi-disc albums in disc sections and see separate album and track groups under
  artist appearances. ([Issue #187](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/187), [PR #188](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/188); [Issue #181](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/181), [PR #185](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/185))
- Create DJs from Now Playing and select newly saved DJs without reopening the picker.
  ([Issue #142](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/142), [PR #176](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/176); [Issue #177](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/177), [PR #178](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/178))
- Place favorite hearts beside album titles and complete more German interface translations.
  ([Issue #183](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/183), [PR #186](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/186); [PR #179](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/179))

- Keep track actions focused on the current track, with device choices in the Cast picker and
  Connect controls rather than extra menu rows during local playback. ([Issue #231](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/231), [PR #235](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/235))

## Bug fixes

- Return the Library to the top after an explicit refresh and align artist appearance tracks.
  ([Issue #190](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/190), [PR #191](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/191); [Issue #195](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/195), [PR #196](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/196))
- Allow owners to delete Smart Playlists whose track editing is read-only.
  ([Issue #180](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/180), [PR #184](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/184))
- Restore transparent animation surfaces on Linux X11 and improve Windows menu and dialog
  stability during animated playback. ([Issue #153](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/153), [PR #199](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/199); [Issue #136](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/136), [PR #197](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/197))

- Keep macOS animation layers aligned after resize and prevent Stats for Nerds from redrawing
  the main window; improve playback-control accessibility. ([Issue #227](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/227), [PR #228](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/228); [Issue #219](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/219), [PR #229](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/229))

## Upgrade notes

- The automatic database upgrade preserves existing downloads. Returning to v2.8.0 requires
  restoring a pre-upgrade database backup while retaining downloaded audio files.
  ([Issue #150](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/150), [PR #182](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/182))

## Known issues

- Cast needs online provider media and a reachable local network. Physical macOS verification
  and broader offline, lyrics and audio-effect support remain follow-ups.
  ([macOS #221](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/221), [hardening #223](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/223))
- Further Linux popup performance and accessibility verification remain open, including the
  full-app CPU budget. ([Linux #220](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/220), [CPU #203](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/203))
- Android TV and Naviamp Connect remain beta. iOS is unsigned; Windows and macOS packages
  are not publisher-signed.
